evidence.exact_span: The Group aims to reward executives based on their position and responsibility, with a level and mix of remuneration which has both fixed and variable components.
Remuneration for certain individuals is directly linked to the performance of the Group. A cash bonus and incentive payments are dependent on KPIs being met.
